issues: 时钟本体清楚，但箭头与残影只能表示小幅移动，难以唯一判断要表达一分钟、即将整点还是泛指时间；表盘没有可读数字。
reviewEvidence.reason: 长针残影并未准确对准相邻小刻度，刻度间隔也不规则，不能用作准确一分钟示意。
reviewEvidence.method: Previous generator inspected the raw image. Recovery reviewers viewed each numbered image individually with targets hidden; root compared observations against exact game senses and visually rechecked ambiguous or precision-sensitive cases. Prior context exposure is disclosed where applicable.
